name: ai-fly
description: ai-fly — peer-to-peer HTTP/WebSocket bridge with AI-ready presets, over OpenDWeb fabric

scripts.test:all: vitest run && pnpm test:integration && pnpm test:e2e
scripts.app:build: pnpm webui:build && pnpm app:icons && pnpm build && pnpm app:verify
scripts.app:verify: node --input-type=module --eval "const fs=await import('node:fs');const {resolveOpenTrayPackage}=await import('@opentray/packaging');const dirs=fs.readdirSync('dist',{withFileTypes:true}).filter(d=>d.isDirectory()).map(d=>'dist/'+d.name+'/opentray-app-manifest.json').filter(p=>fs.existsSync(p));if(dirs.length===0)throw new Error('opentray-app-manifest.json not found under dist/');for(const m of dirs){const r=await resolveOpenTrayPackage(m,{artifactRoot:'dist'});if(!fs.existsSync(r.runtimeHostPath))throw new Error('staged runtime host missing: '+r.runtimeHostPath);console.log('[app:verify]',m,'->',r.runtimeHostPath)}"
